data.name: Bascomb
data.long_meaning: From the Old English words 'bas' meaning base and 'combe' meaning a valley or a heap, this name might have referred to someone who lived at the base of a hill or a valley.

in_hebrew.name: בַשְׁכוֹם

in_greek.name: Βασκόμβος
in_greek.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek word 'βάσκω' meaning 'to leap' or 'to be quick'. It is also associated with the word 'κόμβος' meaning 'a handful', indicating a strong and vigorous person.

in_latin.name: Bascombus
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latinized form of the Greek name 'Βασκόμβος'.

in_english.name: Bascomb
in_english.long_meaning: A name of English origin, derived from the Old English word 'bæsc' meaning 'hasty' or 'quick', and 'comb' meaning 'a gathering of people' or 'a valley'.
